tax_year.rationale: CalendarYr directly corresponds to the calendar year printed in the form header.

payer_name.rationale: BusinessNameLine1Txt under PayerName is the primary payer name line; blueprint bundles both name lines into one string but this is the closest single-field match — blueprint should split into BusinessNameLine1Txt and BusinessNameLine2Txt if a second line exists.

payer_address.rationale: Blueprint bundles street, city, state, and ZIP into one string; canonical schema splits payer address into PayerUSAddress (with sub-elements) or PayerForeignAddress — blueprint should be refactored into separate address component fields.

payer_tin.rationale: PayerEIN directly maps to the payer's taxpayer identification number labeled 'PAYER'S TIN'.

recipient_name.rationale: RecipientNm directly corresponds to the 'RECIPIENT'S name' field on the form.

recipient_tin.rationale: RecipientSSN maps to the recipient's identification number; the schema uses RecipientSSN for this field (also covers ITINs/EINs in practice).

recipient_address.rationale: Blueprint bundles street, city, state, and ZIP into one string; canonical schema splits into RecipientUSAddress or RecipientForeignAddress sub-elements — blueprint should be refactored into separate address component fields.

account_number.rationale: RecipientAccountNum directly corresponds to the 'Account number' box on the form.

fatca_filing_requirement.rationale: FATCAFilingRequirementInd directly corresponds to the 'FATCA filing requirement' checkbox.

box_1a_total_ordinary_dividends.rationale: TotalOrdinaryDividendsAmt directly maps to Box 1a — Total ordinary dividends.

box_1b_qualified_dividends.rationale: QualifiedDividendsAmt directly maps to Box 1b — Qualified dividends.

box_2a_total_capital_gain_distr.rationale: TotalCapitalDistributionsAmt directly maps to Box 2a — Total capital gain distributions.

box_2b_unrecap_sec_1250_gain.rationale: UnrecapturedSection1250GainAmt directly maps to Box 2b — Unrecaptured Section 1250 gain.

box_2c_section_1202_gain.rationale: CapitalGainSect1202Amt directly maps to Box 2c — Section 1202 gain.

box_2d_collectibles_28_pct_gain.rationale: Collectibles28PercentGainAmt directly maps to Box 2d — Collectibles (28%) gain.

box_2e_section_897_ordinary_dividends.rationale: Section897OrdinaryDividendsAmt directly maps to Box 2e — Section 897 ordinary dividends.

box_2f_section_897_capital_gain.rationale: Section897CapitalGainAmt directly maps to Box 2f — Section 897 capital gain.

box_3_nondividend_distributions.rationale: NondividendDistributionsAmt directly maps to Box 3 — Nondividend distributions.

box_4_federal_income_tax_withheld.rationale: FederalIncomeTaxWithheldAmt directly maps to Box 4 — Federal income tax withheld.

box_5_section_199a_dividends.rationale: Section199ADividendsAmt directly maps to Box 5 — Section 199A dividends.

box_6_investment_expenses.rationale: InvestmentExpenseAmt directly maps to Box 6 — Investment expenses.

box_7_foreign_tax_paid.rationale: ForeignTaxesPaidAmt directly maps to Box 7 — Foreign tax paid.

box_8_foreign_country_or_us_possession.rationale: ForeignCountryOrUSPossessionCd directly maps to Box 8 — Foreign country or U.S. possession.

box_9_cash_liquidation_distributions.rationale: CashLiquidationDistriAmt directly maps to Box 9 — Cash liquidation distributions.

box_10_noncash_liquidation_distributions.rationale: NoncashLiquidationDistriAmt directly maps to Box 10 — Noncash liquidation distributions.

box_11_exempt_interest_dividends.rationale: ExemptInterestDividendsAmt directly maps to Box 11 — Exempt-interest dividends.

box_12_specified_private_activity_bond_i.rationale: PrivateActivityBondIntDivAmt directly maps to Box 12 — Specified private activity bond interest dividends.

state_tax_withheld.rationale: Blueprint models state withholding as an array of objects; canonical schema uses Form1099DIVStateLocalTaxGrp (idx 11) as a repeating group containing StateAbbreviationCd, StateIdNum, StateTaxWithheldAmt, LocalAbbreviationCdTxt, LocalTaxWithheldAmt, and LocalityNm — blueprint should be refactored into an array of structured objects each containing those six sub-fields mapped to indices 15–17 and 12–14.
